messages.author: eef9fd076eba67f4
messages.subject: Character limitation in naming
parts:
I have noticed that featureCounts has a limitation in the number of characters of the feature.

Using dexseq for understanding differential exon expression, where a step aggregates overlapped transcripts / genes, I have noticed that while htseq preserves the entire naming line, featureCounts cut it, making impossible to go on.

An example below.

HTSEQ NAMING PRESERVED
:001

FEATURECOUNTS NAMING CUT
ENSECAG00000032244+ENSECAG00000013000+ENSECAG00000031801+ENSECAG00000036200+ENSECAG00000037775+ENSECAG00000034893+ENSECAG00000034777+ENSECAG00000032175+ENSECAG00000034653+ENSECAG00000038678+ENSECAG00000032663+ENSECAG00000037584+ENSECAG00000038267+ENSECAG0:001

messages.author: bce99ba71cd48eea
messages.subject: Re: Character limitation in naming
parts:
Thanks for the information. Indeed, featureCounts had a limit (256 bytes) on the length of feature names. We have lifted the limit to 32KB; hopefully this is enough for the feature names built by concatenating many gene ids. 
The next release of Rsubread and Subread will contain this change.
